tuto.over:
Congratulations, you've completed the tutorial!
Ready to play with other players?
tuto.goal: In Paper Tales, you are a monarch and you develop your kingdom, while fighting your neighbours.
tuto.turns: The game lasts 4 turns, and each turn has 6 phases:
tuto.recruit: Let’s start the Recruitment phase of turn 1! During the Recruitment, all the players will select 5 Unit cards.
tuto.draft: It is a draft: you select a card you are interested in, and pass the others to your neighbour (to the left at turns 1 and 3, to the right at turns 2 and 4).
tuto.received: All the players selected a card at the same time. You received these 4 cards from your right neighbour.
tuto.pick.hunter: The draft goes on until all the players have selected 5 cards. Select the Hunter.
tuto.pick.free: Select the card of your choice.
tuto.deploy: You have selected your 5 cards: time for the Deployment !
tuto.deploy.kingdom: During the Deployment, all the players place their Units at the same time, face down, in their Kingdom. Your Kingdom has 2 rows: - the Front: its Units fight during the War; - the Back: its Units do not fight, but they produce their resources and apply their effects like the others.
tuto.deploy.cost: Each Unit has a recruitment cost, at the top left of the card: you must pay these coins to deploy it. You start the game with .
tuto.place.spirit: Place the Forest Spirit at the Front.
tuto.place.hunter: The Forest Spirit costs : that is all your gold. Fortunately, the other cards you are going to deploy are free! Place the Hunter at the Front: he only produces at the Front.
tuto.place.farmer: Place the Farmer at the Back: with a Strength of 1, he would be weak in a fight, but he produces wherever he is.
tuto.place.blacksmith: Place the Blacksmith at the Back: she earns you at each Income phase.
tuto.deploy.end: You can keep a single card in hand for the next turn: the others are discarded. End your Deployment by clicking the button in the header.
tuto.reveal:
All the Kingdoms are revealed at the same time.
Each player pays the cost of the Units they have just deployed.
tuto.war.strength: You wage war on each of your 2 neighbours, the left one and the right one. Your Strength is the sum of the Strengths of the Units at your Front: 3 for the Forest Spirit, and 2 for the Hunter, that is 5. The Units at the Back do not fight (with some exceptions, like the Archer).
tuto.war.win: For each neighbour whose Strength is lower than or equal to yours, you win the war and gain 3 Legend points .
tuto.income.gain:
Each player gains <g2/>, plus the gold earned by their cards and buildings.
With your Blacksmith, you therefore gain <g3/> in all.
tuto.build.resources: To build, you need resources: Wood, Food and Crystal. They are produced by your Units and your Buildings, and they are not spent: a building only requires your Kingdom to produce the resources shown on its cost. Your Kingdom produces with the Forest Spirit, with the Farmer and with the Hunter.
tuto.build.levels: Each Building has 2 levels, and a cost for each level. A Building earns 1 Legend point at the end of the game; a Building earns 3 and gives a more powerful effect. A level 2 Building also opens a 5th space at the Front of your Kingdom.
tuto.build.choose: Build directly the level 2 Building of your choice: with , you can build the Tavern, the Barracks or the Town. Click the buildings to learn their effects.
tuto.build.land: Your first Building is free, but each new Building also costs the land cost: per Building already built. Upgrading a Building already built costs no land.
tuto.age: The turn ends with the Age phase.
tuto.age.tokens: Units grow old: - first, each Unit that already has an Age token dies and is discarded; - then, each surviving Unit receives an Age token . Your Units were deployed this turn: they all receive a token , and will die at the end of next turn. Some Units are exceptions, or take advantage of their Age tokens: read their effects carefully!
tuto.help: Did you know? You can click a card, a Building or any element of the game to display its help and the rules that apply to it.
tuto.end:
Turn 1 is over!
You now know the 6 phases of a turn.
Your turn to play: the choices are yours for the rest of the game.
Good luck, Monarch!

help.turn.6: The Units that carry an Age token die; the others get one.

game-rules.name: The rules of this game
two-players.title: With 2 players
two-players.recruit: Recruitment: each Monarch receives 9 Unit cards instead of 5. Each time a card is kept, another one is chosen and discarded before the rest is passed to the opponent.
two-players.war: Wars: a strength equal to or greater than the opponent’s wins 1 War, a strength equal to or greater than twice theirs wins 2.
expansions.btg.units: Its 20 new Unit cards are in the draw pile.
expansions.btg.buildings: Buildings: each Monarch has the Mine, the Tavern, the Temple and the Town, plus 3 Buildings drawn at random among the Barracks and the Buildings of the expansions played.
expansions.wfl.cards: Its 26 new Unit cards and its 18 Legendary Artifacts are shuffled into the draw pile.
expansions.wfl.buildings: Buildings: 2 drawn at random among the Inn, the Sawmill and the Royal Palace are added to the 5 of the base game.
expansions.drawn: Drawn at random for this game: {buildings}. Each Monarch has the same {count} Buildings.
expansions.artifacts.recruit: They are selected exactly as Units are, during Recruitment phase, and the card that you keep for the turn to come can be an Artifact (still a single card).
expansions.artifacts.deploy: They are put into play at the same time as Units, face down, apart from them (at the right of your Buildings). No limit: they do not count towards the 4 (then 5) spots of your Units.
expansions.artifacts.cost: Each Artifact costs <g1/>, plus <g1/> for each Artifact already deployed: the 1st of the game costs 1, the 2nd 2, the 3rd 3… Several in a same turn are counted one after the other. You are never allowed to discard an Artifact in play to reduce the cost.
expansions.artifacts.effects: Their abilities apply exactly as those of Units and Buildings, every turn.
expansions.artifacts.age: They do not age: never add any <age/> on them, they remain in play until the end of the game.
expansions.artifacts.end: At the end of the game, add the <pl/> indicated on each of your Artifacts.
expansions.clar.shadow: Shadow: you can choose to re-trigger the abilities of a Unit that you just deployed during that phase.
expansions.clar.negative: Imp, Servile Minion: you actually earn the Gold indicated as a negative cost, which can pay right away for other Units.
expansions.clar.dryad: Dryad: you can provide any combination of resources that way, at the cost of 1 for 1.
expansions.clar.abbey: Abbey: if your Kingdom produces 2 <food/>, 1 <wood/> and 1 <crystal/>, Abbey earns you <pl4/>.
expansions.clar.port: Port: <pl2/> for each type of resource produced, whatever the amount.
expansions.clar.banner: Banner Bearer: check each condition on its own; with a Unit of cost 3 or more, you earn both <g2/> and <pl2/>.
expansions.clar.harvest: Relic of Harvest: in the Front with 3 <wood/> and 2 <food/>, it earns you <pl5/>; in the Back, nothing.
expansions.clar.jester: Court Jester: discard all revealed cards that are not an Artifact; the Artifact it puts into play costs nothing.
expansions.clar.titan: Titan: you neither pay the land cost, nor the resources of the level 2 Building.
